newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark rises to one-month high against lira.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark rises to one-month high against lira.

text.p: 0931 GMT - Mark sets one-month high vs lira, at upper end of trading ranges vs other European crosses. Traders wary of central banks stepping in to halt weakening of their currencies. So far no signs of intervention cited.
* Mark/lira rises as high as 995.35, highest since April 25. Last at 994.00/50 from 991.90/2.20 yesterday. Traders say Bank of Italy checking prices.
* Italian bonds fall, 10-year BTP spread vs benchmark bund widens to 151 bp from 143 bp at open.

* Italian GDP fell 0.3 percent q/q in first quarter 1997. Weaker-than-expected growth seen making it harder for Italy to meet EMU fiscal criteria. Cabinet to discuss three-year economic plan, the DPEF.
* Mark/Swiss rises amid flight to safe haven, last at 82.90/93 centimes vs 83.25/28 yesterday.
* Mark/Paris at 3.3797/02 vs 3.3804/09 late Thursday in Europe. Traders sensitive to rumours of private polls before second round of French elections Sunday.
* Buba's Welteke says Bonn can avoid dispute with central bank by dropping plan to revalue assets.
